bio.text: Brooke Boden, a Republican, represents District 21 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Boden as serving a third term.
The biography describes Boden as a small business owner, FAA-certified aircraft repairman and licensed insurance agent, and a former co-chair of the Warren County Republican Central Committee.
It lists Indianola High School, DMACC and Simpson College under education, and says Boden was raised in and lives in Indianola.
